note: Timor-Leste, read on the Migration Service's own pages (migracao.gov.tl, under the Law on Migration and Asylum, 11/2017) on 2026-10-30; fees are in US dollars, the country's currency. A performer's engagement is a specialised cultural activity 'as an artist', the Temporary Stay Visa's: US$50 for a grant or an extension, valid for the contract up to one year and extendable for equal periods, for the specified work with the specified employer or sponsor; the extension's processing time is up to 30 days (kept as the decision time). The Working Visa is for employment or service contracts certified by SEFOPE: US$100, one year at most, extended for equal periods; lodged in Dili or at an embassy or consulate abroad (either, as for the Temporary Stay Visa). The Temporary Resident Permit, Type A, for professional activity, is lodged in person in Dili (US$100, renewal US$100), stays two years and is renewable on equal terms, and permits work and study. The Permanent Resident Permit (US$150, lodged in Dili, no limit to its validity) asks ten consecutive years' legal residence, or six years holding a temporary residence permit (6 kept as that permit's years to it), among other grounds. Whether these years count toward naturalisation isn't on the pages and isn't kept.

sources.title: Migration Service of Timor-Leste, Temporary Stay Visa
sources.said: Specialized activities, including cultural, sporting, scientific research, journalistic or highly qualified activities as an artist, sportsman, researcher, foreign media correspondent, or highly qualified technician; ... Applications may also be lodged at an Embassy or Consulate abroad prior to arrival. ... The fee for initial application and any extension is US$50, payable in cash at the time of application. ... If engaged in specialized activities, valid for the contract or mission period up to a maximum of one year, which may be extended for equal periods. Work of the specified type with the specified employer or sponsor is permitted. ... Processing time ... Up to 30 days.

sources.title: Migration Service of Timor-Leste, Working Visa
sources.said: The work visa is valid for a maximum period of one year, it may be extended for equal periods and allows multiple entries. ... Applications may also be lodged at an Embassy or Consulate abroad prior to arrival. ... Initial application: US$100 ... The employment and employer are legitimate and the conditions of employment satisfy relevant employment laws as certified by SEFOPE.

sources.title: Migration Service of Timor-Leste, Temporary Resident Permit
sources.said: for the exercise of professional activity; ... The application is to be lodged in person at the Migration Service Headquarters in Vila Verde, Dili. ... Application for grant: US$100 ... 2 years stay period, multiple entries. ... Work and study are permitted. ... Renewable on equal terms.

sources.title: Migration Service of Timor-Leste, Permanent Resident Permit
sources.said: The permanent residence permit has no limit to its’ validity. ... Applications must be lodged within the country at the Migration Service headquarters in Vila Verde, Dili. ...
